name: Ledger records are kept ten years and old logs are purged
title: SC-11-02-03 Ledger records are kept ten years and old logs are purged
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given records older than the retention horizon
When retention is reviewed
Then ledger records are kept for ten years and expired logs are purged
